title: Signed up for one newsletter and now I get forty emails a day
body: I used my real address to grab a discount code back in March. Within about two weeks I was getting mail from companies I have never heard of. Unsubscribing does nothing, half of them just come back under a slightly different name. I have no idea which one of them sold it.
author: demo_user
top_comments: The unsubscribe link is how they confirm the address is live. Never click it.
This is why I use a different address for every single signup now.

extra.angle: the moment one signup poisoned the whole inbox

title: My inbox has become completely unusable and I cannot find real mail anymore
body: I missed a message about a job interview because it was buried under promotional mail. Filters help for about a week and then everything shifts again.
author: demo_user_two
top_comments: Aliases fixed this for me overnight.

extra.angle: the real cost is the mail you miss
